coordinate_stage_reconciliation.cause: E1/E4 gate geometry is raw FrameDet. Final CSV postprocessing moved 221 common FN pairs across the 10um boundary, and 81 additional officially matched FN pairs have a synthetic/pruned endpoint absent from FrameDet.

e4.decision_rule: PASS only if at least one predeclared appearance ranker has higher top-1 accuracy than physical distance on all 2-4-candidate confusable edges and the paired video-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for the improvement excludes zero. Otherwise FAIL.

ncc_contract.3d: zero-mean unit-norm NCC over the full 16x32x32 centroid-aligned patch
ncc_contract.lateral: zero-mean unit-norm NCC over the axial-max 32x32 projection

pca_contract.descriptor: per-patch normalized 4x8x8 block means (3D) or 16x16 lateral-max block means
pca_contract.leakage_control: five-fold video-grouped CV; PCA mean/basis fit on training-video patches only

e5.decision_rule: PASS only if fixed-feature, fixed-ridge video-grouped out-of-fold ROC-AUC is at least 0.70 with video-cluster bootstrap lower 95% bound above 0.60, and balanced accuracy is at least 0.60 with lower bound above 0.50.

feature_contract.classifier: L2-ridge logistic regression, ridge=1, class-balanced training weights
feature_contract.controls: up to four without-replacement one-child adjacent nodes per division, same video, nearest frame
feature_contract.future_center: mean GT successor centroid (two daughters for division; one successor for control)
feature_contract.leakage_control: five-fold grouped CV by video; standardization and model fit within training videos

raw_detection_cache.geometry_role: pre-smoothing FrameDet coordinates used by the association gate

provenance.scope: fold-0 held-out 58 minus frozen excluded identity
